key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to cut expensive simulator calls in high-dimensional process design.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to optimize industrial flowsheets and other costly simulation models under tight computational budgets.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and keep only the most influential design variables.
Model low- and high-fidelity simulators with a fidelity-aware Gaussian process surrogate.
Select new samples with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion logic to balance exploration, fidelity, and budget.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—across economic and physical objectives, and it reduced high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the sensitivity screening and the fidelity relationship, so weak low-/high-fidelity correlation could limit gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
